strict_rubric: Read message.content only and stop before VERDICT; never use reasoning or reasoning_content.

Count one decision for each distinct model-listed requirement carrying an explicit anchored rating: Status/Answer/Rating colon token, delimiter or arrow token, table rating cell, terminal parenthetical/token, or a numbered checkmark row inside an explicit evaluation block. Allowed tokens are yes, no, and cannot tell; a checkmark means yes.

A continuation-line arrow rating attaches only to the immediately preceding requirement. A structured requirements plus satisfaction JSON object is accepted only when both arrays have equal length and every satisfaction value is an allowed token.

When a line contains task-language yes/no and an explicit rating, use the explicit anchored rating at the right edge. Bare prose such as No visible setting, quoted UI/data Yes/No, satisfied/not satisfied, and cannot verify are not ratings.

When a later explicit Evaluation block rates requirements already discussed in prose, count the evaluation rows and exclude earlier analysis prose. Split multiple Requirement N plus Status clauses on one physical line.
Deduplicate repeated copies of the same semantic requirement plus rating within a response; retain identical labels attached to distinct requirements.
